limitations: Characteristic two is excluded; mixed-characteristic finite local rings are excluded.
Only square-zero traceless 2x2 matrices, not arbitrary nilpotent matrices.
No irreducible-component classification is claimed for two-tuples or nonreduced jet multiplicities.
Historical priority is provisional; generic homogeneous cone jet theorems may imply a specialization.
scientific_integrity: Exact theorem for odd-characteristic finite fields, arbitrary tuple length at least two and equal-characteristic truncated polynomial rings; proof uses primitive smooth lifting and homogeneous quadratic origin-fiber reduction. Component statement restricted to tuple lengths at least three, and reduced underlying jet spaces. Small-field computations corroborate and do not prove all-length assertions. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: Congruence counts and jet components of nilpotent commuting tuples in sl(2)
